scope: Record-only copies of fixed EXP004/009 source; no new experiment, model run, request expansion, data-path change or scientific validation claim.

observer_api.identity: _cache.return_array(event_name, value) must record and return the exact original value object without mutation
observer_api.disabled: No NTL_CACHE_EXPORT means NullObserver; no cache IO. Observer module must still be staged.
observer_api.capture_error: CaptureFailure(SystemExit) or equivalent non-Exception failure must escape original optional-component except Exception blocks; never turn a writer failure into COMP/ATLAS SKIPPED.
observer_api.context: Controller must freeze run_id, input/model/runtime/source fingerprints, exact scope, requested member/gate set and conditional required events before inference.

header_required: SHA256 of each exact effective UTF-8 input text after original fillna/astype handling
identity_contract.text_policy: Hashes only in identity metadata; no eval truth or true prompt IDs enter inference. Use exact-text hashes, not normalized text hashes as an equivalence substitute.
identity_contract.cross_component: Main and comp must have identical ordered IDs/text hashes/label order and same run context; main comp_loaded must bind the actual comp file hash and float32 serialization to that comp component.
identity_contract.provenance: Freeze and verify resolved train/test/public files, glob order/selected checkpoint paths, all consumed weights/readouts/tokenizer/config bytes and dependency versions outside the algorithm. ID equality alone is insufficient.
identity_contract.reuse_scope: Same ordered full batch only. Content grouping, centred heads, comp test-side standardisation, ATLAS routing and Sinkhorn are batch-dependent; taking arbitrary subsets of stored final scores is not rerunning the pipeline.

fields.value: ORIGINAL_CALL; identity return, one original evaluation

array_semantics.main_members: members is the insertion-ordered original LP dict of native-dtype N x18 already weighted contributions; twin/gauss ineligible rows are zero. total is original sum(LP.values()). Preserve order and values; never re-softmax or weight them again.
array_semantics.main_divisor: main_probability.divisor is count(abs(v).max()>0) over LP values, not sum of coefficients. Preserve zero arrays separately from absent members.
array_semantics.main_svc4_margin: Native unnormalized N x18 decision values in original estimator classes order; this matched+pool model is distinct from EXP018 raw-public svc4.
array_semantics.member: probability is the actual argument, log_probability=log(clip(prob,1e-9,1)), weight is scalar, rows is None or the original bool/index selector. Record event sequence; replay the original indexed += operation, not a reordered reduction.
array_semantics.style_margin: Each style_margin_context is immediately followed by one style_margin return_array event. Plain has N rows; centred has sum(style_mask) rows in flatnonzero order. Capture classes. TINY training self-tests call decision_function directly and are deliberately not captured as evaluation margins.
array_semantics.style_routed: Original full P_style after plain/centred replacement, before its sole 1.516 contribution. Raw margins cannot be recovered exactly from clipped probabilities if this event pair is missing.
array_semantics.comp_before_gates: Native N x18 accumulated LOGIT before any family gate; gates contains raw fitted score matrices. groups/masks bind both content+GLM grouping and Stylegram grouping.
array_semantics.family_gate_applied: Native arrays for one ordered update: indices=(k,), raw_score/gate_log_probability/base=(N,k), strength/family_mass=(N,), logit=(N,18) after update. Raw Claude-LoRA values are log-probabilities, other gate values are margins. Preserve claude,claude_lora,gpt,gemini,glm order and exact family columns.
array_semantics.comp_component_end: logit retains original native precision; serialized_logit must equal logit.astype(float32), matching comp_logit.npy. Main loads/reorders this float32 array and computes COMP_P at that precision.
array_semantics.atlas_requested: rows are original global test indices selected at this execution; margin/P are after main+comp mix. Selection is margin<.3 only when configured positive and N>=50; otherwise original all-row branch. No hook expands rows.
array_semantics.atlas_batch: local_rows index original requested_rows; global_rows=requested_rows[local_rows]. probability_native uses ATLAS native_labels before label permutation. completed_mask is cumulative request-local mask after this batch. Native labels must be a permutation of the18 canonical labels.
array_semantics.atlas_returned: probabilities=(R,18) in canonical LABELS order; completed_mask=(R,) bool; completed_rows=requested_rows[completed_mask]. Unscored entries are zero-filled placeholders, never valid probabilities. Replay uses only completed entries.
array_semantics.pre_sinkhorn: probability is normalized P after ATLAS mixing; retain native dtype.
array_semantics.sinkhorn_applied: balanced_probability is Q after100 updates; logits=(1-weight)*log(P+1e-12)+weight*log(Q+1e-12). Target is derived anew from predicted marginal and frozen smoothed train prior for each counterfactual; do not freeze baseline target as a new algorithm.
array_semantics.typography: logits_before is _v38_before_hard, not any hard-post mutated tot. evidence=(N,18); train_class_counts=(18,), train_marker_hits=(18,M), test_marker_matrix=(N,M), rates=(18,M), global_rate/feature_weights=(M,), word_count and all gates=(N,). Counts/hits/Xte allow Bernoulli evidence reconstruction without saving text. Recompute confidence_gate for changed upstream logits; word_count remains a captured input unless actual texts are independently supplied.
array_semantics.dtype: Save every existing numerical array in its original dtype/shape. No universal float32 cast, renormalization, centering, clipping, rounding or changed probability interpretation in recorder. Object arrays must be converted only in recorder-owned identity metadata; never mutate input arrays.

coverage_requirements.empty_groups: No eligible rows legitimately omit grouped comp contribution calls; record group mask and declare conditional zero contribution. Missing positive-weight all-row members is not this exception.
coverage_requirements.completion: Event presence alone is not completeness. Validate exact keys, sequence, shapes, finite values, probability sums, masks/indices/labels, expected group conditions, output hashes and main/comp identities. Required positive-weight members/gates missing or skipped must block full-stack acceptance.
coverage_requirements.atlas_full_baseline: Every requested row of every active bundle must be completed for full-baseline reusable acceptance. Preserve partial batches/returned masks with PARTIAL status; a zero-filled row or untouched main probability cannot stand in for an ATLAS score.
coverage_requirements.counterfactual: For each later arm, recompute its request set and require requested subset of cached completed rows. Otherwise status NEEDS_ADDITIONAL_ATLAS_SCORES. Capturing only original baseline requests does not guarantee GPU-free A1-A3 replay.
coverage_requirements.small_or_fake_data: SMOKE, fake_test, sim, FAST_COMMIT placeholders and3 public examples are engineering evidence only. They cannot be marked clean OOF, independent validation or complete hidden-test scientific results.
coverage_requirements.original_final_output: main component_end occurs after original typography overwrite and diagnostics. Verify final parquet IDs/predictions against typography logits and atomic cache manifest; an earlier successful parquet write is not final completion.

storage_requirements: Unique run/component output roots and exclusive lock; no overwriting old runs or silent resume.
Copy mutable arrays synchronously before original code can mutate/reuse them; recorder must not modify flags, dtype, values or RNG state.
Write arrays/metadata atomically and commit manifest only after required event and final output checks; partial files remain clearly incomplete.
Record native byte hashes, sizes, shapes, dtypes and full event order; safe NPZ/NPY without pickle.
Unknown/duplicate unexpected events or mismatched snapshots fail closed rather than borrowing a prior run.

original_side_effects.risk: A late model failure before main_members loses the aggregate snapshot. main_svc4_margin is early; this implementation does not checkpoint every LP assignment.

Generic embedding cache names lack input/source hashes. Existing cache may silently feed stale arrays; active l24/enc bypass it. Controller must isolate or independently verify that cache, not bless it by recording.
Features/classifiers are deleted. Record margins/contributions at their existing computation sites; never recompute later or assume fitted models were persisted.
Missing Claude API/lightgbm/LoRA/token heads/gate shape can silently skip requested branches. Capture and validate actual activation against frozen member plan.

Fixed comp files are non-atomic and share global names; old matching IDs can pass despite changed texts. Original code catches load errors and continues without comp. Require current-run hashes and text-bound identities.

Wall-clock budget, invalid scores, probe and broad exceptions can truncate ATLAS. Capture IO changes elapsed time and COMP_SEC; keep original clocks/budgets and report coverage, never compensate the clock silently.
save_lp is aggregate/pre-typography; first submission is overwritten by typography. Neither alone proves final-stage cache completeness.

Notebook writefile cells can overwrite generated scripts; generated __file__ changes module directory. Stage exact gauss.py and observer/cache dependencies and prevent later overwrite without changing original data paths.
Shell pipe through grep can hide the model subprocess exit code and warning logs. Controller must verify original process failure plus cache receipt, never rely on grep success.

tests_required_before_runtime.assertion: Both exact source SHA values; every AST anchor unique; strip observer import/init/capture and unwrap return_array gives exact original AST. Changed/repeated source and existing destination rejected.
tests_required_before_runtime.current_status: PASS in memory; no generated files or original script execution

tests_required_before_runtime.assertion: Null and file observers leave aliased arrays/dicts, dtype/flags, object identity returned by return_array and RNG states unchanged; missing event, duplicate, disk failure and malformed arrays fail closed.

Synthetic native float32/64 arrays cover main sum/divisor, masked comp additions including clipping, ordered family gates, comp float32 disk boundary, ATLAS partial masks, Sinkhorn and typography. Compare original vs instrumented final arrays and argmax, not only cached formulas.

Stub estimators count calls: raw-margin capture uses original decision_function once; no fit/forward/feature call added. Plain/centred context matches exact row indices; training self-test is not evaluation.

No eligible groups, empty requests, N<18/N<50, missing optional head, COMP load failure, invalid/partial ATLAS, capture failure inside try, pre/post typography failure all produce truthful incomplete/synthetic status.

Synthetic tests use deterministic injected/fake clocks outside production source. Real comparison retains clocks and budgets; exact same source/input/model/runtime and full requested coverage required. Near-budget coverage mismatch cannot be hidden by tolerances.

Only when separately authorized: observed model execution with matching IDs and required members, native cached arrays replay to original final logits/predictions and final parquet. AST/synthetic checks alone do not establish this.

scientific_limits: No current independent full-stack OOF is created by recording full-official-trained checkpoints.
Historical EXP004 input/model byte identity is still bounded by available bindings.
This file neither extends source data acceptance nor authorizes GPU, remote operations, submission or A1-A3 execution.
